, in general, MongoDB is more efficient than SQL Server in the execution of queries in the data warehouse.

The main takeaway from our work is that
MongoDB has better performance than SQL Server for queries with a high number of joins and a low number of records.
, for small and medium sized data warehouses, MongoDB performs better than SQL Server.
